observations: Validate migration and concurrent transitions: success

exact_head_static_observations: The pending scan groups by converted_user_id and orders by MIN(updated_at), then converted_user_id, before applying the bounded LIMIT.
Each selected pending user is rotated by updating updated_at before the authoritative eligibility/activation check, so blocked and transiently failing users move behind untouched pending users.
The focused regression with limit=2 processes a blocked prefix (users 1 and 2), then a second reconciliation reaches later eligible user 3 and activates it.
A sibling regression with a transiently failing prefix (users 11 and 12) still reaches later eligible user 13 on the next reconciliation.
The existing same-batch failure-isolation regression remains present, proving one per-user failure does not stop the following user.
Agent-first Tests completed successfully on the exact material head, so the new starvation regressions executed in the repository test suite.

audit_remediation.observation: The reconciler now implements durable queue rotation using persisted updated_at ordering, preserving bounded work while guaranteeing repeated scans progress beyond blocked or failing prefixes.
